# BNC League (BNC 籃球聯賽)

> Hong Kong local basketball league brand hosted by SUPER LEARNING (https://www.suhksport.com/). Official site for schedules, standings, match results, and league news.

## Main pages

- [繁體中文首頁](https://bncleague.com/zh-hk)
- [简体中文首页](https://bncleague.com/zh-cn)
- [English home](https://bncleague.com/en)
- [比賽 / Matches](https://bncleague.com/zh-hk/matches)
- [關於我們 / About](https://bncleague.com/zh-hk/about)
- [賽事新聞 / News](https://bncleague.com/zh-hk/news)

## Data

- Match statistics and fixtures are published as BNC League data; detailed scores are provided via ScoreLab (linked from the Matches page).
